term: excluded middle and scoped truth decisions
definition: TruthCore.Logic.ExcludedMiddle is ∀p : Prop, p ∨ ¬p. LanguageLaws takes this as an explicit conditional premise, not a kernel axiom or a proved truth. The helper local_agreement only needs P v ∨ ¬P v for admissible P at the collapsed witness v; global excluded middle supplies these decisions. Negation closure remains a separate domain premise.
note: This records the existing formal logical meaning for the S5 experiment, without newly attributing or defending its truth. The independent corpus statement STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE records its separate philosophical defense.
